title: Software Development Engineer
jd_text:
What You Can Expect

Join the Zoom Contact Center engineering team at a genuinely exciting moment: we are building an AI-powered analytics engine that acts as a virtual data analyst for our customers, moving beyond traditional reporting to create intelligent agents capable of understanding natural language and reasoning through complex data problems. As an entry-level backend engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to implement backend services that power AI reasoning, planning, and analytical tasks — gaining foundational skills at the intersection of scalable systems and modern AI development. The work you build here will directly shape how contact center teams around the world access insight and make decisions. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Zoom Contact Center team is at the forefront of Zoom’s next-generation cloud-based customer engagement platform. We are building intelligent agents capable of understanding natural language and reasoning through complex data problems, providing actionable insights that improve contact center efficiency. We move fast, collaborate closely, and care deeply about the quality and impact of what we ship.

Responsibilities

- Implement backend services using Java and Spring Boot to support AI-powered applications within the Zoom Contact Center platform.
- Build prompt strategies, context management logic, and basic agent workflows in collaboration with senior engineers.
- Develop task execution logic, data handling pipelines, and error management for AI-driven data flows.
- Instrument services with logging and monitoring tools to track performance, latency, and correctness across testing and production environments.
- Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and senior engineers to translate analytical requirements into working, production-ready code.
- Contribute to production-grade AI evaluation and orchestration pipelines (LLMOps), working with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), semantic search, AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen), and large-scale OLAP databases (ClickHouse).

What We’re Looking For

- BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (recently graduated or within the last 1–2 years), or equivalent experience, with foundational software engineering exposure through internships, coursework, or personal projects.
- Familiarity with backend programming in Java, Python, or a similar object-oriented language.
- Basic understanding of relational (SQL) or non-relational (NoSQL) database design.
- Curiosity and foundational knowledge of AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel) gained through projects or coursework.
- Eagerness to learn distributed systems, real-time streaming protocols (WebSockets), and LLMOps practices in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum:

$73,300.00

Maximum:

$169,500.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure;  there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

09/18/26

Ways of Working

Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.

Benefits

As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.

About Us

Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.

We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

jd_text:
About the Team

DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt are one global team building the future of local commerce. Our products power millions of interactions between consumers, merchants, and couriers every day, in cities around the world. Together, we’re combining global scale with deep local understanding to deliver what’s next. You’ll help build and operate reliable, scalable technology that improves the experiences of consumers, merchants, and delivery partners across our global platform. Our Engineering team tackles complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace -  from creating intuitive product experiences to designing the infrastructure and backend systems that help local commerce thrive.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

You’ll work alongside a mentor, manager, and experienced engineers while contributing to real products and systems. As you build your technical knowledge, you’ll take on increasing ownership and see how your work affects the people and businesses using our platform. Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Develop, maintain, and ship production-ready software with support from your mentor and team

- Write clean, testable code and contribute to code reviews, version control, and engineering best practices

- Learn the systems and technical areas your work contributes to, including how they operate at scale

- Apply feedback and coaching to strengthen your technical skills and problem-solving approach

- Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to solve problems for consumers, merchants, and delivery partners

We’re excited about you because you have…

- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, graduating between Fall 2026 and Summer 2027

- At least two previous software engineering internships or equivalent practical experience, with no more than two years of full-time professional experience

- Experience using at least one object-oriented programming language, such as Python, Java, or Kotlin

- A solid understanding of algorithms and data structures

- Experience working with databases and technologies such as SQL

- Experience writing clean code, using version control, and creating unit tests

Nice to Have

- Curiosity about using AI-powered tools to support software development, problem-solving, and learning, alongside an understanding of how to evaluate their outputs and use them responsibly

- Experience analyzing and improving the efficiency, scalability, or stability of software systems

- Interest in developing, releasing, and operating large-scale web applications

- Familiarity with systems monitoring, live deployments, or continuous integration

- Experience solving real-time technology problems

- Familiarity with service-oriented architecture, API development, or systems design

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll begin your career by contributing to technology used in the real world every day, with mentorship and support from experienced engineers. As your skills grow, so will the scope of the problems you can own. You’ll learn how large-scale systems behave in production, see the impact of what you build, and work with teammates across different disciplines, countries, and brands.

What We Offer

- Premium healthcare and comprehensive health benefits

- Wellness expense reimbursement

- Paid parental leave

- Benefits and perks designed to support your health, wellbeing, and development

Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer New Grad
jd_text:
About us

At Roadrunner, we’re replacing the broken CPQ software that Sales teams have complained about, worked around, and given up on for years. Not improving it - replacing it. We’re building a new agentic stack called PQA - Prompt, Quote, Approve, designed for the enterprise, on a data model built for how pricing actually works today.

We’re Kleiner Perkins’ first incubation since Glean, led by second-time founders with successful exits, and a team of engineers from Snowflake, Databricks, Citadel, Meta, Robinhood, Brex, and so on. We’re in-person in San Francisco, and we’re just getting started.

What you'll do

- Embed with our customers. You'll sit with the RevOps and Sales leaders who live inside Roadrunner every day, turn their hardest pricing and approval problems into shipped features, and stay on the hook until they're actually solved - not just handed off to support.
- Own delivery end-to-end, in production. From technical discovery through go-live, you're the engineer who scopes it, builds it, and keeps it running.
- Turn one-off solutions into product. Every customer-specific integration or workflow you build feeds back into Roadrunner's core platform. The pattern you build for customer #1 is the feature customer #10 gets out of the box.
- Ship AI agents in the field. Deploy and tune proactive agents - quoting recommendations, deal modeling, multi-step approval workflows - against real customer data and real deal pressure, then iterate on what actually breaks.
- Be the fastest feedback loop in the company. You're often the first to see where the product breaks under real enterprise complexity. You carry that back to the core team the same day, not next sprint.

What you'll bring

- Strong engineering fundamentals - from coursework, internships, or projects. You don't need a track record of shipping to production yet; you need to be able to build fast without cutting the corners that matter.
- Real curiosity. You want to know why something broke, not just that it broke - and you'll dig through an unfamiliar codebase or a customer's system until you find the actual answer.
- Ambition. You want real ownership fast, not a backlog of tickets, and you're ready to earn it.
- Comfort with ambiguity - from a hackathon, a research project, or an internship where nobody handed you a spec.
- Clear, direct communication - with engineers and with the non-technical people you'll be sitting across from.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to be onsite with customers when it matters.
- Based in SF or excited to relocate - we're an in-person team.

Bonus points if…

- You've interned somewhere and shipped code that real users touched.
- You've built something on your own - an app, a tool, a research project - because you wanted it to exist, not because a class required it.
- You've spent time close to customers or end users, even outside of engineering (support, tutoring, ops), and know what it's like to translate someone's problem into something you build.
- You've picked up a new language, framework, or domain fast because a project needed it.
- You have a side project. Tell us what it is and why you built it.

What we offer

- Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family.
- Lunch and dinner, as well as snacks and coffee to keep you energized.
- Take what you need vacation policy.
